title: PIO growth-stages overhead broiler-house montage (Figure 3)
description: Committed manifest for a tiny real-camera reference asset: the four-frame montage of overhead broiler-house imagery from Figure 3 of the PIO (Poultry Images with Offline annotations) dataset paper. The binary is not committed; it is fetched into the runtime home by scripts/fetch_demo_assets.py and verified against the sha256 recorded here.
attribution: Figure 3 from the Scientific Data article at DOI 10.1038/s41597-026-07114-5, © The Authors 2026, licensed under CC BY 4.0.
limitations: not spatially aligned with simulated birds
